meta.parties: Pedris Et Al. v. Fernando Et Al

rules.statement: A mutual will, unless its wording specifically applies to the estate of the first dying only, can be effective as the separate will of the survivor if no new will is made.
rules.supporting_quote: "Unless the words of the joint will are such as to apply to the estate of the first dying only, I imagine the will would be effective as the separate will of the survivor if the survivor made no new will."
